# AccuWeather

AccuWeather provides global current conditions, forecasts, alerts, MinuteCast precipitation forecasts, and lightning data.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/accu-weather/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete Locations** (read-only): Return location-name suggestions for all locations, cities, or points of interest, optionally restricted to a country.
- **Get Administrative Area** (read-only): Return one administrative area by country and administrative-area codes.
- **Get Country** (read-only): Return one country by AccuWeather region and country codes.
- **Get Current Conditions** (read-only): Return current weather observations for an AccuWeather location key, optionally including extended details and weather photos.
- **Get Daily Forecast** (read-only): Return a 1, 5, 7, 10, or 15-day forecast for a location key.
- **Get Daily Indices** (read-only): Return 1, 5, 10, or 15-day lifestyle-index forecasts for all indices, one group, or one index at an AccuWeather location.
- **Get Historical Current Conditions** (read-only): Return the past 6 or 24 hours of current-condition observations for an AccuWeather location key.
- **Get Hourly Forecast** (read-only): Return a 1, 12, 24, 72, or 120-hour forecast for an AccuWeather location key.
- **Get Index** (read-only): Return metadata for one AccuWeather lifestyle index.
- **Get Index Group** (read-only): Return the lifestyle indices belonging to one AccuWeather index group.
- **Get Lightning Forecast** (read-only): Return forecast lightning probabilities for latitude/longitude coordinates.
- **Get Location** (read-only): Return full location metadata for an AccuWeather location key.
- **Get MinuteCast Forecast** (read-only): Return minute-by-minute precipitation conditions for latitude/longitude coordinates.
- **Get Radar and Satellite Imagery** (read-only): Return recent radar and satellite image metadata and URLs for an AccuWeather location at a selected resolution.
- **Get Region** (read-only): Return one AccuWeather region by region code.
- **Get Translation Group** (read-only): Return translated strings for one AccuWeather translation group.
- **Get Tropical Storm Current Position** (read-only): Return the latest observed position of a government-issued tropical storm.
- **List Active Tropical Storms** (read-only): Return active government-issued tropical storms globally, by basin, or by basin and government storm ID.
- **List Administrative Areas** (read-only): Return administrative areas globally or within a country, one provider page at a time.
- **List Countries** (read-only): Return countries globally or within a specific AccuWeather region, one provider page at a time.
- **List Index Groups** (read-only): Return lifestyle-index groups and their identifiers.
- **List Indices** (read-only): Return all supported lifestyle indices and their identifiers.
- **List MinuteCast Color Codes** (read-only): Return full or simplified color-code metadata used in MinuteCast precipitation output.
- **List Neighboring Cities** (read-only): Return cities near an AccuWeather location key.
- **List Recent Lightning Strikes** (read-only): Return recent lightning strikes within 1 to 60 miles of latitude/longitude coordinates as a GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
- **List Regions** (read-only): Return AccuWeather geographic regions and their codes.
- **List Supported Languages** (read-only): Return AccuWeather-supported languages with numeric IDs and language codes.
- **List Top Cities** (read-only): Return top-ranked AccuWeather cities globally or within one region.
- **List Top City Conditions** (read-only): Return current weather conditions for a requested number of globally ranked cities.
- **List Translation Groups** (read-only): Return available AccuWeather translation groups and their identifiers.
- **List Tropical Storm Forecasts** (read-only): Return forecast positions and intensity for a government-issued tropical storm.
- **List Tropical Storm Positions** (read-only): Return the observed position history of a government-issued tropical storm.
- **List Tropical Storm Statuses** (read-only): Return government-issued tropical storm status categories and wind-speed definitions globally or for one basin.
- **List Tropical Storms by Year** (read-only): Return government-issued tropical storms for a year, optionally filtered by basin and government storm ID.
- **List Weather Alarms** (read-only): Return threshold-based weather alarms for the next 1, 5, 10, or 15 days at an AccuWeather location.
- **List Weather Alerts** (read-only): Return active government-issued weather alerts for a location key.
- **Resolve Language Identifier** (read-only): Convert an AccuWeather language code to its numeric ID or a numeric language ID to its code.
- **Search Administrative Areas** (read-only): Search administrative areas by required non-empty name text and optional country and administrative-area code filters, one 25-result…
- **Search City by IP Address** (read-only): Resolve an IPv4 or IPv6 address to an AccuWeather city location.
- **Search Locations** (read-only): Search cities, general locations, postal codes, or points of interest by text and optional geographic filters.
- **Search Locations by Coordinates** (read-only): Find the nearest general location, city, or point of interest to latitude/longitude coordinates.
